items.name: Slowed
items.text: You have fewer actions. Slowed always includes a value. When you regain your actions at the start of your turn, reduce the number of actions you regain by your slowed value. Because slowed has its effect at the start of your turn, you don't immediately lose actions if you become slowed during your turn.

items.name: Slow
items.text: A hollow husk is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

items.name: Memory Drain
items.text:
Requirements The hollow husk has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

---

Effect Memories flow from the grabbed creature into the empty void that is the hollow husk's mind. The hollow husk deals the creature 3d6 mental damage, and the creature must attempt a DC 16 Will save save.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is Stupefied 2 for 1 minute.
